what: Two inverted cells, each holding a symbol per letter, stay hidden. On hover they sweep past one at a time, starting from the first letter (.05s delay, .016s stagger), each cell shrinking horizontally (.16s) in a flash, and the letter’s own glyph re-forms at .4s — a menu hover that feels like a terminal character flickering into another.

options.each: Time for the text to re-form (s), default 0.4
options.flash: Duration for the flip cell to shrink (s), default 0.16
options.gap: Delay between slots of the same letter (s), default 0.016
options.--fx-flash-bg: Inverted cell background, default text color (currentColor)
options.--fx-flash-ink: Flip cell symbol color, default var(--kf-bg)

use: Menu 1 · Green text link is style="--fx-flash-bg: var(--kf-accent)"

from.where: shared.css·shared.js header menu, button links, footer email and social links (original Scramble — letter i gets .n opacity 0→1 .4s at .05i, the two .f follow at .016 and .032s after with scaleX 1→0 and opacity 1→0 .16s, all power4.inOut, symbols fixed by a hash of the letter position)

note: The symbol is picked by hashing the letter or word position — same every time it opens. Empty elements get nothing attached
